title: The week's picks (what Claude writes)
description: pick_moments.py: which clip moments become shorts, with the shots to render for each and the pattern each follows (if any), whether each pattern the week must use fits, and a decision for every moment marked kept (F7). Structured-outputs subset: every field required.

week_theme.description: One line: what this week's footage is about.

pattern_fit.description: One entry for each pattern in the brief's must_use ([] when there are none).

kept.description: One entry for every moment marked kept, including those picked for shorts.

name.description: Lowercase words joined by dashes, unique this week, e.g. sprint-heard.

moment.description: The moment's ref from the digest: <stem>#<rank>.

pattern.description: The name of the library pattern this short follows, or "" for none.

angle.description: The one idea the short is about.

hook_idea.description: The first two seconds, on screen and spoken.

why.description: Why this moment, in a sentence.

name.description: Lowercase, unique within the pick, e.g. top or mind.

subject.description: Who the camera follows (pov is always yours).

layers.description: Her mind drawn in; [] for the store alone.

alpha.description: Her mind alone on a transparent background, for a picture in picture (needs layers).

start_offset.description: Seconds added to the moment's start (negative starts earlier); 0 to start with the moment.

end_offset.description: Seconds added to the moment's end; 0 to end with it.

fits.description: true when one of the shorts follows it.

play.description: When it doesn't fit: the moment to play for it, a sentence to the developer ("" when it fits).

use.description: short: picked above; long: save for the monthly video; bug: a bug report, not marketing; skip: not usable.
